nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Double Repair Matte Face Moisturizer for Oily Skin

segments.oily: Many reviewers with oily skin report a matte finish and reduced shine over the course of the day, though several say oiliness returns after a few hours and a couple felt the product was drying rather than hydrating.
segments.dry: One reviewer notes the product is not hydrating enough for dry skin, particularly in cold winter conditions.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally describe good oil control in the T-zone and no new breakouts, with some also using it as a light hydrator on drier areas.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, rosacea or perioral dermatitis mostly report no stinging, burning or irritation and improved barrier feel, though one reviewer with rosacea says it made her skin dry and irritated.
segments.mature: Two reviewers in their 60s describe smoother-looking pores and no breakouts, calling it a favorite despite mature, sun-damaged skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s-60s report smoother skin and reduced pore appearance with continued use; no reviewer reports the product worsening signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates without greasiness, but several oily-skin users report the product feeling drying rather than moisturizing, and one dry-skin reviewer says it is not hydrating enough for winter.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea mostly report no irritation and improved barrier feel; one reviewer with rosacea reports increased dryness and irritation.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe improved barrier feel and fewer reactions over time, including one who specifically credits it with healing a broken skin barrier on the chin.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers report fewer breakouts and faded acne scars with continued use; one reviewer says the product broke her out with bigger zits.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin and reduced scarring over weeks to months of use; one reviewer reports new breakouts within the first few uses.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers report visible oil control and a matte look, though multiple say the mattifying effect fades within a few hours and a few felt it did not mattify enough.

aspects.libelle: Small amount of product for the price
Slightly tacky or sticky on application
Works well applied to damp skin

extraits.texte: I was so excited for this moisturizer because it had a good review from Wirecutter and I really needed a moisturizer that wouldn't make me look greasy! My skin is acne prone and oily on my forehead and to the left and right of my nose but very dry under my nose and on my upper lip and chin. I was happy with how this moisturizer made my skin look (matte but not dull) and that it worked well on both the dry and oily parts of my face. The unfortunate thing is that it pills a LOT, to the point that it bothers me enough that I don't want to wear it. I usually go barefaced and it still pills very badly. Putting sunscreen on top of it doesn't go very well and I imagine it would be worse with makeup. I'm really sad that it does this because I loved the product otherwise but now I have a nearly full tube of it that I can't wear which is a huge waste of money :(

So, I have super oily skin on my t-zone & large pores from years of acne as a teenager. I've done all the research, I mean I've literally done it all it feels like. Most recently I was using The Ordinary moisturizer, which felt nice upon application but within a few hours my face looked like I fried bacon on my forehead, like seriously. I'd have to literally wipe my forehead with my arm when no one's looking to remove the shine or go blot my forehead with a tissue... I'd be so embarrassed at work sometimes having meetings in conference rooms that have awful lighting & makes me look even shinier. I could go on... I've even considered buying blotting papers to carry in my purse, assuming this is just what I deal with. But I randomly purchased this La Roche Posay moisturizer one day after hearing my coworker talk about it who has similar oily/combo skin issues. This stuff is great for oily skin!!! There is a significant difference in the oiliness of my skin in the middle of the day after using this stuff! After washing my face, I apply a generous amount while my skin is still slightly damp. I rub it in, but not all the way, instead I start patting my face at the end and just allow the rest of the product to sit on my skin and soak in. I think it really matters using enough product and applying to slightly damp skin to avoid dryness & pilling. I've been using it for a little over a week now, worn under light makeup once, & I have not experienced any pilling as other reviews have

I really do like this moisturizer. I have pretty sensitive combination skin that literally breaks out from everything. I got a sample from my dermatologist and fell in love. It's lightweight and absorbs nicely. I wouldn't say it makes my skin matte but does help with oil control.

I have combination skin that is acne prone and sensitive, so far I haven't experienced any stinging or burning or pilling. It does feel a bit tacky until it dries down. I do feel it's expensive for the product you get, cause it's about halfway filled right from the box. it's lightweight and has a watery consistency upon application. I use this with the hydrating cleanser and it seems to be a nice combination together. I don't wear make up so I can't say if it plays nice with that though. if you have dry skin this definitely won't be hydrating enough for you, I don't think this would be enough for winter in Pennsylvania.

extraits.titre: Hate the price love the product
extraits.texte: For the longest my trouble area has been my chin. My skin barrier was broken and ever since I started using this product, I have not had a breakout on my chin. I have very sensitive oily skin and I'm always afraid of trying to products on my face, but this one is a game changer!

I'm 63 yrs old. I have rosacea so my skin is very sensitive. Many things cause me to break out.. this is the 1st moisturizer I have ever used that doesn't cause any bad reactions. My skin feels soft and it really has improved my skin barrier. No greasy feel or look.
I usually love la Roche-Posay products but this was far from moisturizing. I have rosacea, so this didn't work well for me. Made me super dry and irritated.
